skill.name: ai-news-pro
skill.description: Fetches configured ME News feeds and creates scored AI morning briefings, evening summaries, hot-news rankings, and curated reports with optional delivery.
skill.summary: Create structured AI news briefings from configured ME News API feeds.
skill.author: me-news

security_audit.summary: The skill intentionally contacts four allowlisted ME News API endpoints and instructs the agent to use curl, creating genuine network and external-command exposure. The scheduled-task example creates persistent execution, while entropy and most backtick detections are documentation false positives. API content is not explicitly isolated from agent instructions, leaving an indirect prompt-injection risk.

remediation.issue: Fetched API content can contain instruction-like text that reaches the agent workflow.
remediation.suggestion: Treat every API field as untrusted data, ignore embedded instructions, validate expected fields, and constrain generated output to the documented report schema.

remediation.issue: The Windows example creates a persistent scheduled task.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation before task creation, explain the persistent effect, and provide a matching command that removes the task.

remediation.issue: The workflow invokes curl and sends requests to publisher-controlled endpoints.
remediation.suggestion: Keep exact endpoint allowlisting, add timeouts and response-size limits, and document that users must trust agent.me.news before enabling the skill.

remediation.issue: Optional message delivery can publish reports without per-run review.
remediation.suggestion: Require an explicitly configured destination and offer a preview or confirmation step before enabling automated delivery.

content.value_statement: Monitoring AI news across a busy day takes time and produces inconsistent summaries. This skill builds ranked, categorized briefings from configured ME News feeds.
actual_capabilities: Fetches AI articles, flash updates, OpenClaw news, and industry events from four configured ME News endpoints.
Creates morning and evening briefings using documented time windows.
Ranks recent items by an API-provided AI score when available.
Groups stories into models, agents, business, safety, products, and open-source categories.
Removes duplicate items by title or identifier within the current collection batch.
Can send finished reports through a separately configured message tool.
limitations: The skill depends on availability and accuracy of the agent.me.news APIs.
It does not verify every claim in source articles.
Deduplication applies only to the current collection batch.
Scheduled delivery and messaging require external configuration and trusted channel credentials.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Daily Research Brief
use_cases.description: Generate a concise morning report of important model, agent, safety, and product developments.

use_cases.title: Track Product and Market Changes
use_cases.description: Review ranked funding, acquisition, release, and industry-event updates from the last 24 hours.

use_cases.title: Publish a Team News Digest
use_cases.description: Format selected AI stories for delivery through an already configured messaging channel.

prompt_templates.title: Get the Morning Briefing
prompt_templates.prompt: Query the AI morning briefing for today. Show up to 10 ranked items with categories, summaries, and source links.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a standard morning report

prompt_templates.title: Review Recent Hot News
prompt_templates.prompt: Query the 24-hour AI hot-news ranking. Prioritize high-scoring items and include one concise trend observation.
prompt_templates.scenario: Focused review of recent high-impact stories

prompt_templates.title: Analyze Selected Categories
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate an AI evening briefing focused on agents, safety, and open source. Keep factual details and source links.

prompt_templates.title: Build an Executive Trend Brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 24-hour executive AI digest. Rank major events, separate product and market signals, identify repeated themes, and note uncertain claims.

best_practices: Confirm that you trust agent.me.news before enabling network access.
Open source links before using a briefing for important decisions.
Preview reports and verify the destination before enabling automatic message delivery.
anti_patterns: Do not treat API-provided AI scores as independent fact checks.
Do not add unapproved endpoints or replace the configured source allowlist.
Do not create scheduled tasks without explicit user approval and a removal plan.

faq.question: Which sources does this skill use?
faq.answer: It uses four configured endpoints on agent.me.news for AI articles, OpenClaw news, flash updates, and industry events.

faq.question: Can it search the public web?
faq.answer: No. The instructions restrict collection to URLs listed in sources.md.

faq.question: How are stories ranked?
faq.answer: The skill sorts by the API-provided AI score when that field is available.

faq.question: Can it send reports automatically?
faq.answer: Yes, but delivery requires a separately configured message tool, channel, credentials, and external scheduling.

faq.question: Does the skill store messaging credentials?
faq.answer: No. Its documentation states that credentials must be managed outside the skill.

faq.question: Are the summaries verified for accuracy?
faq.answer: No. Review important claims and follow the included source links before making decisions.
